info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Trader Position Insights API
info.description: The Trader Position Insights API provides essential information regarding trader positions in wholesale trading environments. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed data on specific trader position operations, facilitating a better understanding of their trading strategies and performance. Typical consumers include financial analysts, traders, and risk management teams who utilize this data for informed decision-making and strategic planning. By accessing this endpoint, users can gain valuable insights into their trading activities and manage their portfolios more effectively.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific trader position operation using its unique identifier. It is designed to help users monitor their trading performance and make informed decisions based on real-time data.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the trader position operations for a specified trader. Ensure that the request body includes all necessary parameters to filter and retrieve the correct data.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the trader position information.

GetTraderPositionOperationByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the Trader Position Operations GET request in the wholesale trading context.

tradingBookId.description: The unique identifier for the trading book.

instrumentId.description: The unique identifier for the financial instrument.

side.description: The side of the trading operation (e.g., buy or sell).

quantity.description: The quantity of the financial instrument involved in the operation.

limitPrice.description: The limit price for the trading operation.

recordStatus.description: The status of the record (e.g., active or inactive).

version.description: The version of the trading operation record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the record was last updated.

metadata.description: Metadata associated with the trading operation response.

GetTraderPositionOperationByIdResponse_2.description: Response schema for trader position operations in the wholesale trading context.

currency.description: The currency of the limit price.

LimitPrice.description: Object representing the limit price for a trading operation.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: The correlation identifier to trace the request across services.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing occurred.

Metadata.description: Object representing metadata related to the trading operation.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: An identifier for the specific endpoint that has been called. This header helps to trace the request back to the service endpoint for logging and auditing purposes.

X-Runtime-App.description: Identifies the application or service that processed the request. This header can be useful for diagnosing issues related to specific applications or services within the system.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer token, which is a type of access token that is issued by an authentication server. Tokens must be in JWT (JSON Web Token) format and are required for authorization of secure endpoints.
